title: 第二十章 凡人杀修士
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
天快亮的时候，两人已经朝灯火相反的方向走了大半个时辰。沈君壁走在前面，走得很快，和平时那个沉稳的码头账房完全不一样。侯紫跟在后面，难得的没有张手接风，因为满腹心事。

    “沈君壁。”侯紫忽然叫住他。

    沈君壁停下脚步，转过身。

    “有件事，之前没跟你说清楚。”侯紫把手从袖子里抽出来，“我也没灵根，没有你所说的灵力，也不是风系功法。我能借风，靠的就是你翻过的那本破书。当我写下风不是风，是没砍出去的刀时，书页的痕纹像活了，我就能借风了。”

    沈君壁沉默了一会儿：“所以你早就知道自己没灵根。”

    “你翻那本书的时候，我才确定。之前我只知道自己体内空空如也，但不确定这算不算灵根。”侯紫往路边一块石头上坐下，“但我来找你，不是要说这个。”

    “那要说什么？”

    “你有没有想过，那两个云霄阁内门弟子，是怎么死在破庙里的？”

    沈君壁愣了一下：“不是说他们自相残杀，你捡了便宜？”

    “让他们自相残杀的人，是我。”

    沈君壁转过身，正面看着侯紫。

    侯紫开始从头讲。不讲功法，不讲借势经，只讲人。

    “那两个人本来在王府做客，却随手杀了小石头，我恨呀。我给他们送茶倒水，每天在旁边看着。黑袍每次打坐，都把包袱放在左手边，右手拔剑顺手。白袍每次进王府，先看黑袍的手，再看黑袍的脸。看手是防他拔剑，看脸是看他有没有在运功。”

    “我在岳州城巷子里混了十几年，见过赌场里把银袋压在胳膊底下睡觉的赌棍，见过巷口卖假药的贩子怎么看人下菜碟。这两个人之间的防备，在别人眼里叫同门情谊，在我眼里叫互相提防。”

    “所以我干了三件事。”

    “第一件事：偷玉佩。趁白袍出去，偷了他一块不怎么拿出来看的玉佩，塞进黑袍的包袱底下，露出半截。白袍不知道自己身上少了东西，黑袍发现玉佩之后以为是白袍来偷东西。两人大吵一架，差点动手。但没出人命。”

    沈君壁瞳孔张大了，插了一句：“你怎么知道白袍不会马上发现？”

    “那块玉佩他不常拿出来看，丢了好几天都没反应。在客栈当小二的时候，客人哪件衣服常穿、哪件压箱底，扫一眼就知道。摸人习惯，是跑堂的基本功。”
content_en:
When it was almost dawn, the two of them had been walking in the opposite direction of the lights for more than half an hour.Shen Junbi walked in front, walking very fast, completely different from the usual calm dock accountant.Hou Zi followed behind, rarely opening his hands to catch the wind, because he was full of worries.

"Shen Junbi." Hou Zi suddenly stopped him.

Shen Junbi stopped and turned around.

"There's something I didn't tell you clearly before." Hou Zi took his hand out of his sleeves. "I don't have spiritual roots, nor the spiritual power you mentioned, nor the wind technique. I can borrow the wind, and it depends on the broken book you turned over. When I wrote that the wind is not the wind, but the knife that has not been cut out, the marks on the pages of the book seem to come alive, and I can borrow the wind."

Shen Junbi was silent for a while: "So you already knew that you have no spiritual roots."

"When you read that book, I was sure. Before, I only knew that there was nothing in my body, but I was not sure whether it was spiritual root." Hou Zi sat down on a stone by the roadside, "But I didn't come to you to talk about this."

"What do you want to say?"

"Have you ever thought about how those two inner disciples of Yunxiao Pavilion died in the ruined temple?"

Shen Junbi was stunned for a moment: "Didn't you say that they killed each other and you took advantage?"

"I was the one who made them kill each other."

Shen Junbi turned around and looked at Hou Zi head-on.

Hou Zi started from the beginning.It doesn’t talk about exercises, it doesn’t talk about leveraging sutras, it only talks about people.

"Those two people were guests in the palace, but they killed Xiao Shitou. I hate it. I brought them tea and water, and watched every day. Every time Heipao meditated, he put the bag on his left hand, and drew the sword with his right hand. Every time Baipao entered the palace, he first looked at Heipao's hands, and then looked at Heipao's face. The hands were to prevent him from drawing the sword, and the face was to see if he was using his skills."

"I have been hanging out in the alleys of Yuezhou City for more than ten years. I have seen gamblers in casinos sleeping with their money bags under their arms, and I have seen how the dealers selling counterfeit medicines in the alleys look at people's orders. The defense between these two people is called camaraderie in the eyes of others, but it is called mutual wariness in my eyes."

"So I did three things."

"The first thing: steal the jade pendant. While Bai Pao was out, he stole a piece of jade pendant that he didn't often take out, and stuffed it under Hei Pao's bag, leaving half of it exposed. Bai Pao didn't know that he was missing something. When Hei Pao discovered the jade pendant, he thought it was Bai Pao who came to steal something. The two had a big quarrel and almost started a fight. But no one was killed."

Shen Junbi's pupils widened and he added: "How do you know Baipao won't find out right away?"

"He doesn't often take out the jade pendant to look at it. He lost it for several days and didn't respond. When I was a waiter in an inn, I could tell at a glance which clothes the guests usually wear and which ones are packed at the bottom of the box. The habit of touching people is the basic skill of the waiter."
